purpose: Teach: コミットメント/印刷物/公職/増産/ふさわしく/簡略/お買い得/取り直し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究への、本気で、絶対、コミットメント、絶対、強く、絶対、持って、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — commit yourself fully to this research. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, direct authority. Opens on his name with a slight pause to command attention. Mid-range tone, no softness but not harsh. The weight of expectation delivered as simple fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、印刷物、絶対、研究室で、絶対、配布、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The papers have been printed and distributed in the lab.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Soft, careful pace. Each item ticked off methodically. Small breath before 'distributed' — showing he's kept track. Trailing upward slightly on gratitude, like an unfinished thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 公職、本気で、絶対、経験者、絶対、教授、絶対、研究室に、絶対、いらっしゃるか、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Do we have experienced researchers — professors — in the lab who can guide this?
lines.style: Questioning, probing gently. Slight lift on the question, as if testing Ren's grasp of the problem. Not impatient, but precise. A mentor checking what his student has already considered.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、増産、絶対、ペースで、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward on increasing our publication pace.
lines.style: Measured, steady cadence. No rush in the delivery. Matter-of-fact about progress. Slight lean on 'increasing' — he's aware this is ambition. Closes quietly with gratitude, as if completing a report.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学者に、本気で、絶対、ふさわしく、絶対、振る舞え、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Conduct yourself like a scholar. That's what I expect.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Opens with weight on 'conduct.' Low, even tone throughout. A directive more than a request. The pause after 'scholar' lets it land — this is about identity, not just action.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の、本気で、絶対、簡略、絶対、要約、絶対、用意、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared a concise summary of the paper.
lines.style: Precise, efficient. Clipped slightly — showing competence and discipline. No wasted breath. Quiet pride on 'prepared,' understated. Closes with small nod of respect built into the gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会の、本気で、絶対、お買い得、絶対、参加プラン、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the conference attendance options and confirm which plan fits our needs.
lines.style: Directives stacked with purpose. Clear, authoritative. Each task marked off as separate but connected. Closes on the final task without trailing — this is not a request for feedback, it's an instruction to execute.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データの、本気で、絶対、取り直し、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're handling the retesting of experimental data and moving ahead with it.
lines.style: Focused, professional. Steady pace, no hesitation. Shows he's understood the scale of work. Slight firmness on 'retesting' — acknowledging the added effort. Closes with quiet determination in the gratitude.
